name: classroompath
description: ClassroomPath SaaS - DNS whitelist management for educational institutions
author: balejosg

scripts.install:all: git submodule update --init --recursive && npm install && cd upstream/openpath && npm install
scripts.build:api: cd upstream/openpath && npm run build --workspace=@openpath/shared && npm run build --workspace=@openpath/api
scripts.build:spa: cd upstream/openpath && npm run build --workspace=@openpath/shared && npm run build --workspace=@openpath/react-spa
scripts.test:e2e:auth-email: CP_FAKE_EMAIL_DELIVERY=0 E2E_REAL_EMAIL=1 PLAYWRIGHT_WORKERS=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/auth-email.spec.ts --retries=0
scripts.test:e2e:auth-email:staging: BASE_URL=$(node scripts/deploy-targets.mjs get staging publicUrl) npm run test:e2e:auth-email
scripts.test:ci-regression: node --import tsx --test tests/agent-docs-consistency.test.ts tests/deployment.test.ts tests/firefox-release-metadata.test.ts tests/openpath-required-checks.test.ts tests/release-evidence.test.ts tests/release-gate-policy.test.ts tests/wait-for-release-candidate.test.ts tests/workflow-config.test.ts
scripts.test:release-gate:staging: RELEASE_GATE_URL=$(node scripts/deploy-targets.mjs get staging publicUrl) RELEASE_GATE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=1 npm run test:release-gate
scripts.test:smoke:staging: SMOKE_TEST_URL=$(node scripts/deploy-targets.mjs get staging publicUrl) npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:smoke:production: SMOKE_TEST_URL=$(node scripts/deploy-targets.mjs get production publicUrl) npm run test:smoke
scripts.size:check: test -d upstream/openpath/react-spa/dist && npm run size --workspace=@openpath/react-spa || echo 'SKIP: upstream/openpath/react-spa/dist not built, skipping size check'
scripts.db:test:reset: docker compose -p classroompath_test -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml down -v && docker compose -p classroompath_test -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml up -d postgres
